chain.title: MUTCD latest edition + Model Traffic Code as adopted
written and verbal directions of the traffic engineer

geometry.note: S(geom): no published work-zone geometry. Section 700 'Traffic Technical Specifications' is permanent signal/lighting infrastructure, not work-zone TC. MUTCD latest edition governs.

deltas.rule: Barrels/drums will be used on all night time operations (stipulation #16), with flashing lights.
deltas.baseline: MUTCD permits cones for many night operations with retroreflective banding

effect.note: drums replace cones on night ops

deltas.rule: CONSTRUCTION AHEAD and MEN WORKING signs required for each direction of travel affected (stipulation #6).

All TC signs turned away from motorists' view when work is not occurring (#33); signs graffiti-free and visually maintained (#30); vehicles unattended no more than 5 minutes (#26); emergency vehicle access must be allowed (#3).

windows.note: Stipulation #31: 'All work is for Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. until 3:30 p.m., unless noted otherwise in the Special Conditions.'

hours.override_note: Deviation from Special Conditions needs Traffic Engineer pre-approval (#32); the permit text grants the traffic engineer written AND verbal directive authority.

personnel.rule: Flagger for each direction of travel affected (#12); safety vests on all ROW workers (#28). No TCS or flagger certification requirement stated — a notable gap vs. neighbors.

devices.rule: The 34-stipulation checkable device list: Type 'A' frame barricades w/ flashing lights (#2); Type I/II/III barricades w/ flashing lights (#13-15); channelization devices (#9); guide barrels/drums w/ flashing lights; ROAD CLOSED / ROAD CLOSED TO THROUGH TRAFFIC (#4-5); MERGE + LANE CLOSED AHEAD pairs (#7-8); turn-prohibition and KEEP LEFT/RIGHT signs (#10-11); detour as specified (#17).

hazards.rule: TC permits requiring an extension beyond the permit expiration date are assessed $500.00 PER DAY (stated twice: process sheet + TC form).

tiers.label: Traffic Control Permit
tiers.definition: Separate from the construction permit. Form checkboxes: Oversize Vehicle · Special ROW Usage · ROW Closure · Speed Limit Reduction (construction zone only) · Parking Restriction Change · Other. The municipal construction-zone speed-reduction permit type is the first in the corpus.

notes.rule: Licensed Thornton contractor required; General Conditions extend it: all contractors and/or subcontractors shall be licensed by the City before any work is commenced.

source.doc: Thornton Construction & TC Permit handout, General Conditions

notes.rule: Performance surety = cash escrow or Letter of Credit ONLY for work within existing City ROW (Code 2-272(f)(3)), amount priced from the CDOT cost data manual, latest revision. 85% refund at 60 days post-initial-acceptance EXCEPT street cuts: 100% held to final acceptance; landscaping guaranteed at 150%.
Potholing required on ALL Thornton utilities — 'The contractor cannot proceed until all Thornton utilities are found.' Pre-marking within 10 ft of disturbance centerline before locates.
Use tax 3.75% x 50% of contract valuation, prepaid at permit; equipment declarations for gear >=$2,500; reconciliation within 90 days; 36-month audit SOL with 10% penalty.

source.doc: Thornton Construction & TC Permit handout, use-tax sheet

multi_agency.rule: Prairie-dog relocation letter for grading; CDPHE stormwater >1 acre; 404 permits; floodplain permit where applicable.

items.label: TC permit processing
items.note: '$50 processing + computed closure fee (by duration)' — undated handout, provisional.

fees.note: Duration-based closure fee computed per permit. Percent-based charges (inspection 1% of contract cost, plan review 0.5%, sewer TV 3%, $30 minimum) are not renderable as fixed items.

meters.note: TC permit extension beyond expiration date: $500.00/day.

leads.label: TC permit lead time
leads.note: 5 business days if no construction permit needed. Rendered conservative pending clarification.

conflict.label: TC permit lead time

sources.value: 10 business days minimum (5 if no construction permit)
processed 2 business days (5 with street closure)

conflict.verdict: Handout may state processing time vs. the page's advance-notice ask; render 10 until the city clarifies.

notices.rule: Residents contacted (#1) and must comply with posted parking (#25). High-impact TCP: VMS + resident/business notice >=5 business days.

source.doc: Thornton Construction & TC Permit handout + ROW page

items.rule: Permit copy on site at all times, front AND back shown on request (#34).
